title: Admin Authentication Bypass & RBAC Missing in admin-service (REMEDIATED)
description: In Run 1, admin-service authMiddleware unconditionally injected a hardcoded super_admin user into all requests. In Run 2 re-audit, this vulnerability was independently tested and verified as REMEDIATED: real Bearer JWT verification, signature checking, expiry checks, and strict RBAC are now enforced on all admin routes.

trace.description: Bearer JWT extracted from authorization header, verified against process.env.JWT_SECRET.
Token payload decoded, validated for admin role, and assigned to req.user.
Role permissions checked against permissions mapping; unauthenticated or unauthorized requests rejected with 401/403.

evidence.description: Bearer JWT verification active; fails closed with 401 if missing, invalid, or expired.
gatewayAdminAuth verifies admin JWT before proxying /api/v1/admin/* requests.

reason: REMEDIATED in Run 2. Hardcoded super_admin assignment completely eliminated. Requests without valid signed admin Bearer JWT receive HTTP 401 Authentication required. Gateway pre-validates tokens.

title: Global Hardcoded Internal Service Shared Secret (REMEDIATED)
description: In Run 1, a static key was hardcoded as DEFAULT_INTERNAL_KEY across 25+ files. In Run 2 re-audit, all 25+ occurrences were purged. All microservices now import centralized timingSafeEqual internalAuth and getInternalServiceKey() from @bharatclap/shared.
claimed_root_cause: Static secret string 2a6c1e55... hardcoded as default fallback in internalAuth and internalApi across microservices.

trace.description: Extracts x-internal-service-key from incoming request headers.
Loads expected key via getInternalServiceKey() requiring runtime environment variable.
Compares buffers using crypto.timingSafeEqual; fails closed with HTTP 403 if invalid or unset.

evidence.description: Default fallback value removed; requires environment-injected INTERNAL_SERVICE_KEY.

reason: REMEDIATED in Run 2. Grep search confirms 0 occurrences of hardcoded key in source code. Centralized timingSafeEqual internalAuth deployed across all services.

title: Unlimited Password Reset OTP Guessing & Lockout Absence (REMEDIATED)
description: In Run 1, verifyResetOtp lacked attempt tracking, lockout, and rate limiting. In Run 2 re-audit, atomic 5-attempt tracking, 5-minute expiry enforcement, HTTP 429 lockout, plaintext otpCode purge, and gateway rate limiting were implemented.
claimed_root_cause: verifyResetOtp in auth-service did not increment attempts, check expiry, or lock challenges on failed attempts.

trace.description: authOtpLimiter rate limits requests to /api/users/verify-reset-otp.
5-minute ageMs expiry check verified before cryptographic comparison.
Atomic pipeline update increments attempts; locks challenge to consumed with 429 on 5th attempt.

evidence.description: Atomic attempts increment and 5-attempt lockout logic.
Plaintext otpCode storage purged from MongoDB document updates.

reason: REMEDIATED in Run 2. Password reset OTPs expire after 5 minutes, lock permanently after 5 attempts returning HTTP 429, and are protected by gateway rate limiting.

title: Razorpay Payment Verification Signature Bypass & Hardcoded Secret Fallback (REMEDIATED)
description: In Run 1, paymentController accepted mock_signature and order_mock_* prefixes to bypass cryptographic verification. In Run 2 re-audit, mock signature bypass and hardcoded fallback secrets were completely removed; mandatory RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET with timingSafeEqual is enforced.
claimed_root_cause: isMock signature bypass and hardcoded secret fallback BEx2OBXwYoQI4YHuVIYh7cSB in paymentController.ts and walletController.ts.

trace.description: Payment verification receives razorpay_order_id, razorpay_payment_id, razorpay_signature.
Retrieves process.env.RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET; fails closed with 500 if unconfigured.
HMAC-SHA256 signature calculated and verified using crypto.timingSafeEqual.

evidence.description: Mock bypass removed; crypto.timingSafeEqual signature verification required.
crypto.timingSafeEqual and RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET required for wallet recharge.

reason: REMEDIATED in Run 2. Mock order generation and signature bypass eliminated. Cryptographic HMAC verification with timingSafeEqual and required server secrets enforced.

title: Default Admin Role Assignment on Token Verification in authMiddleware (REMEDIATED)
description: In Run 1, authMiddleware defaulted user.admin_role to support_admin for regular customer/provider users without an admin role. In Run 2 re-audit, admin_role is strictly restricted to authenticated users with user.role of admin or super_admin, and undefined for all customers/providers.
claimed_root_cause: user.admin_role || (uRole === 'admin' || uRole === 'super_admin' ? 'super_admin' : 'support_admin') defaulted non-admin users to support_admin.

trace.description: Incoming request with Bearer JWT token.
Determines isAdmin: uRole === 'admin' || uRole === 'super_admin'.
Assigns admin_role only if isAdmin; sets undefined for standard customers and providers.

reason: REMEDIATED in Run 2. Customers and service providers are explicitly prevented from acquiring default support_admin permissions.

title: Client-Side Route Protection Relies on Unverified Cookie (REMEDIATED)
description: In Run 1, Next.js middleware only checked for the presence of a 'token' cookie without validation. In Run 2 re-audit, middleware parses JWT structure, validates exp expiration, verifies cryptographic HMAC signature when configured, and enforces strict RBAC routing.
claimed_root_cause: frontend/middleware.ts checked !token cookie existence without decoding or verifying claims.

trace.description: Protected route request (/admin/*, /provider/*, /user/*).
parseJwtPayload decodes claims and validates expiration against current timestamp.
RBAC check redirects unauthorized roles to login or landing page, clearing invalid cookies.

evidence.description: JWT structure, exp expiry, and cryptographic signature check in edge middleware.

reason: REMEDIATED in Run 2. Frontend middleware validates JWT structure, expiration, signature, and RBAC, clearing invalid cookies and redirecting unauthorized visitors.

title: Unencrypted Auth Token Storage in Customer Mobile App (REMEDIATED)
description: In Run 1, customerapp stored bearer auth tokens in cleartext SharedPreferences. In Run 2 re-audit, customerapp was upgraded to FlutterSecureStorage (hardware-backed Android Keystore and iOS KeyChain) with automated migration from legacy SharedPreferences.

trace.description: Successful login / verification receives bearer token.
Delegates token persistence to _secureStorage.write.
Purges legacy token from SharedPreferences and stores in hardware-backed secure storage.

evidence.description: FlutterSecureStorage used for all token read, write, and clear operations.

reason: REMEDIATED in Run 2. Customer mobile app uses hardware-backed FlutterSecureStorage and automatically clears legacy unencrypted SharedPreferences tokens.

title: Cleartext Traffic Allowed in Mobile Android Manifests (REMEDIATED)
description: In Run 1, both customerapp and serviceapp AndroidManifest.xml set android:usesCleartextTraffic='true'. In Run 2 re-audit, both manifests have been hardened to android:usesCleartextTraffic='false'.
claimed_root_cause: android:usesCleartextTraffic='true' in customerapp and serviceapp AndroidManifest.xml.

trace.description: android:usesCleartextTraffic explicitly set to false.
android:usesCleartextTraffic explicitly set to false.
Android OS enforces TLS for all network requests, blocking cleartext HTTP transmission.

reason: REMEDIATED in Run 2. Cleartext traffic disabled across all mobile application manifests.
